## Channel Dispatcher

This safe v1 workflow:

1. Receives Notification Engine channel payloads.
2. Validates destinations and message content.
3. Builds ChatGPT, Telegram and WhatsApp dispatch queues.
4. Does not send external messages during manual testing.
5. Creates dispatch-history memory updates.

### Safe mode

`metadata.dispatchEnabled = false`

The workflow only creates previews.

### Future connector mode

Set `dispatchEnabled = true` only after Telegram and WhatsApp connector workflows are configured and tested.

No AI credits are used.
